fusions.name: Prong and Prong
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 100% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crossroads Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps strands round you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on an enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Crossed Strands
fusions.desc: Strings a line of crossed strands 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a strand springs to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
